**Item #:** SCP-TEST-004

**Object Class:** Thaumiel

**Special Containment Procedures:** SCP-TEST-004 is housed in a specialized chamber at Site-██. Access requires Level 4 clearance and approval from at least two members of the O5 Council.

**Description:** SCP-TEST-004 is an ancient bronze mirror, approximately 45cm in diameter. The mirror's surface displays images of **potential future events** when activated according to specific ritual protocols.

The accuracy of SCP-TEST-004's predictions varies based on several factors[[footnote]]See Document TEST-004-ALPHA for complete analysis.[[/footnote]]:

* Temporal distance: Events within 24 hours are shown with 94% accuracy
* Complexity: Simple binary outcomes are more reliable than complex scenarios
* Observer bias: Predictions may be influenced by the observer's expectations

**Addendum TEST-004-A:** Experiment Log

[[collapsible show="+ Show Experiment Log" hide="- Hide Experiment Log"]]
>
> **Experiment Log TEST-004**
>
> **Test 001**
>
> **Date:** ██/██/20██
>
> **Subject:** D-8432
>
> **Procedure:** Subject instructed to ask about weather conditions for the following day.
>
> **Results:** Mirror displayed heavy rainfall. Weather records confirm 47mm of precipitation occurred the following day in the Site-██ region. **Success.**
>
> **Test 002**
>
> **Date:** ██/██/20██
>
> **Subject:** D-8433
>
> **Procedure:** Subject asked about outcome of upcoming containment breach simulation.
>
> **Results:** Mirror displayed successful containment. Simulation resulted in breach being contained in 12 minutes, matching the displayed scenario. **Success.**
>
> **Test 003**
>
> **Date:** ██/██/20██
>
> **Subject:** D-8434
>
> **Procedure:** Subject asked about personal events five years in the future.
>
> **Results:** Mirror displayed fragmented, unclear images. Subject reported seeing "shadows and fire" but could not provide specific details. **Inconclusive.**
[[/collapsible]]

**Addendum TEST-004-B:** Ethics Committee Review

The use of SCP-TEST-004 for operational planning has been approved under strict guidelines:

# Predictions must be independently verified when possible
# No predictions regarding specific individuals' deaths shall be sought
# All uses must be logged and reviewed quarterly
